SELECT 'g1' grp, COUNT(*) tot,
 SUM(CASE WHEN main_cat='Office Products' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) office,
 SUM(CASE WHEN main_cat LIKE '%Electronic%' OR main_cat IN ('Computers','Camera & Photo','Cell Phones & Accessories','Home Audio & Theater','Portable Audio & Accessories','Video Games','Car Electronics') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) elec,
 SUM(CASE WHEN main_cat='Musical Instruments' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) music
FROM items_g1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'g2', COUNT(*),
 SUM(CASE WHEN main_cat='Office Products' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
 SUM(CASE WHEN main_cat LIKE '%Electronic%' OR main_cat IN ('Computers','Camera & Photo','Cell Phones & Accessories','Home Audio & Theater','Portable Audio & Accessories','Video Games','Car Electronics') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
 SUM(CASE WHEN main_cat='Musical Instruments' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM items_g2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'g3', COUNT(*),
 SUM(CASE WHEN main_cat='Office Products' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
 SUM(CASE WHEN main_cat LIKE '%Electronic%' OR main_cat IN ('Computers','Camera & Photo','Cell Phones & Accessories','Home Audio & Theater','Portable Audio & Accessories','Video Games','Car Electronics') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
 SUM(CASE WHEN main_cat='Musical Instruments' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM items_g3;

SELECT 
 SUM(CASE WHEN prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) both_notnull,
 SUM(CASE WHEN prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) prc_only,
 SUM(CASE WHEN prc IS NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) usd_only
FROM items_g2;

SELECT 
 COUNT(*) tot,
 SUM(CASE WHEN i.ref_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) joined
FROM fdbk_g2 f LEFT JOIN items_g2 i ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id;
SELECT COUNT(*) mism FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL AND ABS(prc/100.0 - prc_usd) > 0.005;
SELECT DISTINCT rtg FROM fdbk_g2 ORDER BY rtg;

SELECT 
 COUNT(*) AS total_reviews,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.rtg = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS one_star,
 ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.rtg = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_1star
FROM fdbk_g2 f
JOIN items_g2 i ON f.ref_id = i.ref_id
WHERE LENGTH(f.body) > 500
  AND i.prc <= 4000;

SELECT 
 COUNT(*) AS total_reviews,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.rtg = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS one_star,
 ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.rtg = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_1star
FROM fdbk_g2 f
JOIN items_g2 i ON f.ref_id = i.ref_id
WHERE LENGTH(f.body) > 500
  AND i.prc_usd <= 40;
